summary: WYSIWYG editor for page content built on Tiptap: classic toolbar or Notion-style block mode with a “/” menu, bubble menu, and block handle. Shipped from the separate @dev-community/ui/editor entry point; RichTextContent renders saved HTML with the same typography.
whenToUse: Writing articles, pages, event descriptions, or posts with headings, lists, tables, images, and links.
Comments or notes with light formatting (disable unneeded features with `features`).
Displaying already-saved content read-only with RichTextContent.
whenNotToUse: Plain or multiline text without formatting: use TextArea.
Source code: use a dedicated code editor.
HTML email: use EmailBuilder, which produces markup compatible with email clients.
Critical bundles: the editor loads Tiptap/ProseMirror (import it only on the pages that need it, possibly with lazy()).

props.name: variant
props.description: Fixed (sticky) toolbar above the text, or block editor with a “/” menu, a bubble menu on selection, and a block handle.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial content, as HTML or Tiptap JSON. In controlled mode the content is replaced only when the external value actually differs: the cursor does not reset on every keystroke.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives HTML (empty string if the editor is empty), JSON, and plain text on every change.

props.name: label / aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: Accessible name of the editable area. Without label or aria-label, the localized text “Text editor” is used.

props.name: description / errorMessage
props.description: Help and error text, linked with aria-describedby as in the other fields.

props.name: isInvalid / isRequired / isDisabled / isReadOnly
props.description: Field states, reflected in aria-invalid, aria-required, aria-disabled, and aria-readonly. Toolbars are not shown in read-only mode.

props.name: necessityIndicator
props.description: Required field indicator, as in TextField.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when the editor is empty. In the blocks variant, empty paragraphs show the “/” hint.

props.name: features
props.description: Enables/disables groups: 'headings', 'lists', 'taskList', 'blockquote', 'codeBlock', 'link', 'image', 'table', 'align', 'highlight', 'horizontalRule'. Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, and inline code are always available.

props.name: headingLevels
props.description: Heading levels available in the toolbar, “/” menu, and shortcuts.

props.name: characterLimit
props.description: Character limit enforced on input; shows the remaining characters and announces them politely near the limit.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Live counter below the area. `true` is equivalent to 'characters'.

props.name: onImageUpload
props.description: Enables pasting/dropping images and the upload button in the image dialog. Without it, the dialog asks only for a URL and alt text.

props.name: onImageUploadError
props.description: Reports upload errors (paste, drop, or dialog).

props.name: minHeight / maxHeight
props.description: Height of the writing area; beyond maxHeight the content scrolls and the toolbar stays visible.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Moves focus into the editor on mount.

props.name: onEditorReady
props.description: Escape hatch to the Tiptap instance (commands, events, custom extensions). Also called if the editor is recreated.

props.name: onFocus / onBlur
props.description: Focus and blur of the editable area.

props.name: name
props.description: Adds a hidden input with the current HTML for submission with native forms.

props.name: id / className
props.description: id of the editable area; class on the outer container (ref to the container).

props.name: RichTextContent html
props.description: HTML to display with the editor typography. It is inserted as-is: it must be trusted or already sanitized.

props.name: RichTextContent json
props.description: Safe alternative: the JSON is converted with the editor schema (generateHTML), so unexpected elements and attributes are discarded. Client-side rendering only.

props.name: RichTextContent sanitize
props.description: Sanitization function (e.g. DOMPurify) applied to `html` before rendering.

props.name: RichTextContent as
props.description: Container element.

inherits: RichTextContent also accepts the container’s HTML attributes (className, style, id, aria-*). isSafeRichTextUrl(url, kind?) exposes the URL validation used by links and images.

keyboard.action: Bold, italic, underline (Mod = Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere).
Opens the link popover (URL, open in new tab, remove).
Paragraph / heading of the given level (if enabled).
Align start, center, end, justify (logical: respects RTL).
In lists: increases/decreases indentation; in tables: next/previous cell. Elsewhere Tab leaves the editor.
Moves focus to the toolbar (toolbar variant), to the bubble menu if there is a selection, otherwise opens the action menu of the current block.
Roving-focus navigation between controls; Esc returns to the text, preserving the selection.
Blocks variant: opens the block insertion menu; keep typing to filter.

keyboard.keys: Freccia su/giù, Home/Fine, Invio o Tab, Esc (menu “/”)
keyboard.action: Moves the active option, inserts the block, closes the menu.
Moves the current block up/down (alternative to dragging).

accessibility: The editable area has role="textbox" and aria-multiline="true", is labelled by the label and described by the description, error, and counter; it exposes aria-invalid, aria-required, aria-readonly, and aria-disabled.
Toolbars use the library’s Toolbar (roving focus); formatting buttons are ToggleButtons with aria-pressed reflecting the active marks; every control has a tooltip showing its shortcut.
The “/” menu is a listbox: the editor exposes aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-activedescendant, and a live region announces the active option and the “No results” state.
Every pointer action has a keyboard alternative: block menu with Alt+F10, moving with Mod+Alt+arrows, links with Mod+K.
Images always have an alt text field; links accept only http(s), mailto, tel, and relative URLs, and those opening in a new tab get rel="noopener noreferrer".
Checklist checkboxes have a localized accessible name.
Respects prefers-reduced-motion and forced-colors (borders and focus remain visible).
responsive: The toolbar wraps on narrow screens; controls have targets of at least 32px; the bubble menu scrolls horizontally if it doesn’t fit.
The bubble menu and “/” menu are positioned with floating-ui and stay within the viewport (flip/shift and max height).
Images and tables adapt to the width; wide tables scroll horizontally.
Logical properties only: layout, alignment, and the block handle work in RTL.
customization: Semantic tokens for surface, borders, text, code (mono font), highlight, and focus; the dark theme works automatically.
minHeight/maxHeight control the writing area; className applies to the outer container.
onEditorReady gives access to the Tiptap instance for commands or integrations (e.g. autosave).
RichTextContent shares the editor’s typography CSS: saved content looks identical.
commonMistakes: Passing untrusted `html` to RichTextContent without `sanitize`: prefer `json` or server-side sanitization.
Regenerating `value` from `html` on every render in controlled mode with transformations (e.g. trim): the editor receives a different value and replaces the content.
Treating `characterLimit` as validation: it must be repeated server-side.
Leaving the alt text of informative images empty.

examples.name: Blocks
examples.title: Notion-style block editor
examples.description: Type “/” to insert blocks, select text for the bubble menu, use the handle or Alt+F10 for block actions.

examples.name: ImageUpload
examples.title: Simulated image upload
examples.description: Paste, drop, or upload a file: the upload is simulated with a data URL.

limits: No sanitizer included: `RichTextContent html` is inserted as-is; use `json` or `sanitize`.
`RichTextContent json` is rendered client-side only (in SSR the container is empty until hydration).
Dragging the handle uses native HTML5 drag: it does not work with touch; use the block menu or Mod+Alt+arrows.
Left/right alignments pasted from other sources are ignored (only start/center/end/justify are supported).
No real-time collaboration, comments, mentions, or version history.
Tables cannot be resized with the mouse; rows and columns are managed from the table menu.
